note: The tRNS chunk supplies the transparent 16-bit color values and sets has_trans, causing the decoded image to be compared against tc16.
After IDAT decompression and image creation, has_trans and the 16-bit depth route execution into stbi__compute_transparency16.
For 16-bit images with an added alpha channel, the decoder must initialize both bytes of every synthetic alpha sample before transparency checks use the output buffer.

The 16-bit transparency routine reads decoded 16-bit samples from z->out; if any required output sample byte was not initialized during PNG creation, MemorySanitizer reports the comparison as a use of an uninitialized value.
